panels.title: Big questions
points: How do we know that people walked on the Moon?

panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: Allah made the Moon and gave it phases so that we can count the months and years (Yunus 10:5). Muslims watch for the new Moon to start each month, like Ramadan. People who visited the Moon saw one of Allah's great signs close up.
